title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mohegan Sun Arena, Uncasville | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut, USA, on 16 July 2006.

It was the 22nd show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Recordings from this night were released on Starr’s tenth live album, 2008’s Ringo Starr & His All Starr Band Live 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the Mohegan Sun Arena on 31 July 2003. He returned there on 22 June 2008, 27 June 2010, 17 June 2012, and 20 September 2024..

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
